name: Atlanta
living: the golden crown spire of the tallest tower glows and a slow glint slides up its pyramid top
a red aircraft-warning light blinks slowly on each spire tip
downtown tower windows flicker on and off one by one in the twilight haze
peach and coral pixel clouds drift slowly across the teal sky, with a few stars twinkling above
light-tower lamp banks breathe softly, moths and dust motes drifting through the cones
warm humid haze gently shimmers low over the skyline (a soft heat-haze band)
the little red outfield boards' lamps and the pink heart sign on the wall pulse softly
the dark trees beyond the wall sway a touch in a warm breeze
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
